title: Antifungal metabolites from Myxococcus stipitatus GXUA 01510 for the control of sugarcane Pokkah boeng disease caused by Fusarium sacchari
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23544-23553
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10061E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wang Jiang, Qun Hao Li, Jiasong Guan, Ahmed F. Elkarmout, Zhonghui Ma, Zhiwei Su
The thiazole compounds cystothiazole A (7) and melithiazol F (9) potently inhibited Fusarium sacchari by suppressing its growth and spore germination and disrupting cell membrane integrity.
